                                        "rich_text_description": [
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "PARAGRAPH",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Like Cristiano Ronaldo, azulejo tiles are a Portuguese national treasure. For the Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 9 Elite CR7, we took visual inspiration from the Portuguese icons to show what can be achieved when one dedicates themselves to the craft. Now loaded with a soccer-specific Zoom Air unit, you can put the pedal down in the waning minutes of a match\u2014when it matters most.",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": []
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "PARAGRAPH",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Azulejo Inspiration",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": [
                                                        {
                                                            "inline_style": 1,
                                                            "length": 19,
                                                            "offset": 0
                                                        }
                                                    ]
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "UNORDERED_LIST_ITEM",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "The allover, 1-of-a-kind graphic on the upper pays tribute to some of CR7\u2019s past cleats in an azulejo pattern.",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": []
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "PARAGRAPH",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Welcome to the Field, Zoom",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": [
                                                        {
                                                            "inline_style": 1,
                                                            "length": 26,
                                                            "offset": 0
                                                        }
                                                    ]
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "UNORDERED_LIST_ITEM",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "For the first time in our history, Nike has developed an all-new, soccer-specific 3/4 Zoom Air unit. It sits in the plate and provides an additional level of springy underfoot feel that helps you move faster on the field and create separation when it matters the most\u2014whether you're scoring goals, being first to the ball or going by defenders.",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": []
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "PARAGRAPH",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Drive Your Speed",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": [
                                                        {
                                                            "inline_style": 1,
                                                            "length": 16,
                                                            "offset": 0
                                                        }
                                                    ]
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "UNORDERED_LIST_ITEM",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "The speed cage inside of the structure is made of a thin but strong material that secures the foot to the outsole without adding additional weight for optimal lockdown.",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": []
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "PARAGRAPH",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Dig In, Take Off",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": [
                                                        {
                                                            "inline_style": 1,
                                                            "length": 16,
                                                            "offset": 0
                                                        }
                                                    ]
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "UNORDERED_LIST_ITEM",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Tri-star studs provide multidirectional traction with every step, so you can change directions quickly and confidently. Heel studs provide traction and stability when braking. Toe-off center studs give you traction during explosive starts.",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": []
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "PARAGRAPH",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Improved Fit",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": [
                                                        {
                                                            "inline_style": 1,
                                                            "length": 12,
                                                            "offset": 0
                                                        }
                                                    ]
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "UNORDERED_LIST_ITEM",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Flyknit wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. A redone design improves the fit, so that it better simulates the foot. We did this by conducting multiple wear tests on hundreds of athletes. The result is a more contoured toe box and better lockdown in the heel.",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": []
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "PARAGRAPH",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "Feel the Ball",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": [
                                                        {
                                                            "inline_style": 1,
                                                            "length": 13,
                                                            "offset": 0
                                                        }
                                                    ]
                                                }
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "block_type": "UNORDERED_LIST_ITEM",
                                                "depth": 0,
                                                "text_with_entities": {
                                                    "text": "The upper is made of Vaporposite+, which combines a grippy, grid mesh with a premium material for optimal ball control at high speeds. The material provides a tactile feel across the surface of the upper. It\u2019s soft, but stable and wraps tightly around your foot, giving you a more natural on-ball feel when dribbling, passing or scoring.",
                                                    "inline_style_ranges": []
                                                }
                                            },

product.name: Футбольные бутсы для игры на твердом грунте Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 9 Elite CR7 FG
product.description: Как и Криштиану Роналду, плитка азулежу — это национальное достояние Португалии. Мы разработали бутсы Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 9 Elite CR7, дизайн которых вдохновлен тем, что ассоциируется с Португалией. Они покажут, чего можно достичь, если полностью посвятить себя развитию своего мастерства. Благодаря подушке Zoom Air, адаптированной под футбольную обувь, ты сможешь выложиться на полную в решающие минуты матча.

text_with_entities.text: Like Cristiano Ronaldo, azulejo tiles are a Portuguese national treasure. For the Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 9 Elite CR7, we took visual inspiration from the Portuguese icons to show what can be achieved when one dedicates themselves to the craft. Now loaded with a soccer-specific Zoom Air unit, you can put the pedal down in the waning minutes of a match—when it matters most.
The allover, 1-of-a-kind graphic on the upper pays tribute to some of CR7’s past cleats in an azulejo pattern.

For the first time in our history, Nike has developed an all-new, soccer-specific 3/4 Zoom Air unit. It sits in the plate and provides an additional level of springy underfoot feel that helps you move faster on the field and create separation when it matters the most—whether you're scoring goals, being first to the ball or going by defenders.
The speed cage inside of the structure is made of a thin but strong material that secures the foot to the outsole without adding additional weight for optimal lockdown.

Tri-star studs provide multidirectional traction with every step, so you can change directions quickly and confidently. Heel studs provide traction and stability when braking. Toe-off center studs give you traction during explosive starts.

Flyknit wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. A redone design improves the fit, so that it better simulates the foot. We did this by conducting multiple wear tests on hundreds of athletes. The result is a more contoured toe box and better lockdown in the heel.

The upper is made of Vaporposite+, which combines a grippy, grid mesh with a premium material for optimal ball control at high speeds. The material provides a tactile feel across the surface of the upper. It’s soft, but stable and wraps tightly around your foot, giving you a more natural on-ball feel when dribbling, passing or scoring.
For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields

caption.text: Look what just dropped! 👀 These Mercs inspired by my Portuguese heritage 🇵🇹 are special to me.

summary.title: The Zine: Spring 2022
summary.description:
The Zine uncovers the emerging and niche forms of self-expression, visual aesthetics and more inspired by young people who are sparking conversations around authenticity and identity. 

This season to highlight what’s next for fashion and beauty, we’ve collaborated with one of those people, model and skincare line founder Lori Harvey (@loriharvey), as our first-ever Zine cover star.

guide_metadata.title: The Zine: Spring 2022
guide_metadata.description:
The Zine uncovers the emerging and niche forms of self-expression, visual aesthetics and more inspired by young people who are sparking conversations around authenticity and identity. 

This season to highlight what’s next for fashion and beauty, we’ve collaborated with one of those people, model and skincare line founder Lori Harvey (@loriharvey), as our first-ever Zine cover star.

summary.title: Meet the creators behind the trick shots
summary.description:

summary.title: Perfect Isn’t Real, Tips to Avoid the Pressure
summary.description:
Everyone is worthy of a fun, inspiring and creative experience on Instagram, where there’s a source of community for all. But sometimes the pressure to be perfect online can be overwhelming. We’re focused on helping you to decode not just images on your feed, but the emotions around them — how you feel when you’re on Instagram, how you feel about content and people you come across, how you feel about what you share — and even what it feels like not to share anything at all. Here are some tips and resources from mental health creators, experts and advocates on how to make your experience more positive and uplifting, this month and beyond.

Art by @nubiartuk

product.name: Armani Beauty Code Parfum – Woody Cologne For Men —
product.description: ARMANI CODE PARFUM rewrites the code of a timeless masculine fragrance – infusing the powerful and seductive signature Tonka Bean with fresh notes of iris, sage, and bergamot, to create a woody aromatic blend that is long-lasting and uniquely distinctive. ARMANI CODE PARFUM speaks to a man who rewrites the codes of masculinity – a new seduction that is charismatic, a confidence that is refined, and a self-expression that is authentic. All sizes are refillable in a new, modern bottle design. Refilling your fragrance saves* 38% glass, 67% metal, and 20% plastic. *1 x 75ml + 1 x 150ml vs 3 x 75ml | Armani Beauty Code Parfum - Woody Cologne | 1.7 oz./50 ml | Men's Cologne

caption.text:
Signature scent. The refillable ARMANI CODE PARFUM is set into motion by Bergamot, followed by sophisticated Clary Sage Heart and a base of Resinoid Iris and Tonka Bean Absolute to create a woody, aromatic fragrance.

"The new Armani code is more intense, somehow fresher, has more elements that give it a wider expression." Regé-Jean Page, face of ARMANI CODE.

First photo credit: @Damon_Baker

product.description: ARMANI CODE PARFUM rewrites the code of a timeless masculine fragrance – infusing the powerful and seductive signature Tonka Bean with fresh notes of iris, sage, and bergamot, to create a woody aromatic blend that is long-lasting and uniquely distinctive. ARMANI CODE PARFUM speaks to a man who rewrites the codes of masculinity – a new seduction that is charismatic, a confidence that is refined, and a self-expression that is authentic. All sizes are refillable in a new, modern bottle design. Refilling your fragrance saves* 38% glass, 67% metal, and 20% plastic. *1 x 75ml + 1 x 150ml vs 3 x 75ml | Armani Beauty Code Parfum - Woody Cologne | 1.7 oz./50 ml | Men's Cologne

caption.text:
Signature scent. The refillable ARMANI CODE PARFUM is set into motion by Bergamot, followed by sophisticated Clary Sage Heart and a base of Resinoid Iris and Tonka Bean Absolute to create a woody, aromatic fragrance.

"The new Armani code is more intense, somehow fresher, has more elements that give it a wider expression." Regé-Jean Page, face of ARMANI CODE.

First photo credit: @Damon_Baker

caption.text:
Real Estate Investing Takes Everything! Literally every cent. There’s a phrase for it: “House Poor.”

When we bought our house, we had personal debts, credit card debt...it was a LOT. However, that debt is now paid off, we live in a beautiful home in Los Feliz, and our house is worth almost 3x what we paid for it. This story has happened time and time again for us - we are real estate holy rollers, and we also believe that all the money gets spent regardless, so spend it on assets.

#Housepoor #Realestate #Realestateinvesting #LARealtor

items.title: #BreakingHouseRules
items.description:
In partnership with Goldhouse (@goldhouseco), five creatives sat down for a family meal and an intimate conversation about the ways they’re creating space and confidence for others in the AAPI community to seek similar paths. 

In this conversation, they explore everything from explaining “what they do for a living” to family, to pursuing their passion, the importance of seeing themselves represented in media and what they’re still learning about being a creator.

Meet the five inspiring people who are #BreakingHouseRules.

caption.text:
In partnership with @instagram, we’re excited to present #BreakingHouseRules, a celebration of the young rulebreakers and changemakers who are creating space and confidence for others in the API community to seek similar paths.

In this intimate conversation, five creatives explore everything from explaining “what they do for a living” to family, to pursuing their passion, the importance of seeing themselves represented in media and what they’re still learning about being creators. Watch the full video now and tell us who inspires you in the comments below!

Featuring @joeandohirsh, @veronicapomee, @anikkhan_, @k8sabz, and @notcheetos

                                        "text": "Obesity is preventable and treatable. \nTR-\nObezite \u00f6nlenebilir ve tedavi edilebilir.\n______\nWhat should be BMI (body mass index) for bariatric surgery\u2753\n\ud83d\udcccThe body mass index calculated by dividing the weight of the person by the square of his/her height is over 40; \nPatients who cannot lose weight despite professional support and serious exercise.\nPeople with a body mass index above 35 and obesity-related problems such as diabetes, hypertension, knee and joint pain.\npatients with a body mass index between 30 and 35 who have diabetes, hypertension, asthma and many similar diseases called \"metabolic syndrome\". \nIn some special conditions, obesity surgery is appropriate.\n\n-TR-\n Obezite cerrahisi i\u00e7in BMI (v\u00fccut kitle indeksi) ka\u00e7 olmal\u0131d\u0131r\u2753\n\ud83d\udcccKi\u015finin kilosunun, boyunun karesine b\u00f6l\u00fcnmesi ile hesaplanan v\u00fccut kitle endeksinin 40\u2019\u0131n \u00fczerinde oldu\u011fu; \nprofesyonel destek ve ciddi egzersize ra\u011fmen kilo veremeyen hastalar.\nv\u00fccut kitle endeksinin 35\u2019in \u00fczerinde oldu\u011fu ve obeziteye ba\u011fl\u0131 diyabet, hipertansiyon, diz ve eklem a\u011fr\u0131lar\u0131 gibi sorunlar\u0131n geli\u015fti\u011fi ki\u015filer.\nv\u00fccut kitle endeksinin 30 ile 35 aras\u0131nda oldu\u011fu \u201cmetabolik sendrom\u201d denilen diyabet, hipertansiyon, ast\u0131m ve benzeri hastal\u0131klar\u0131n bir\u00e7o\u011funun \nbirlikte oldu\u011fu baz\u0131 \u00f6zel ko\u015fullarda obezite cerrahisi yap\u0131lmas\u0131 uygundur.\n-\n-\n#healwideclinic \n#healthcare #bariatricsurgery #turkeyhealthtourism\n#sleevegastrectomy #gastricbypass\n#bariatricsurgery #obesitysurgery\n#weightloss #healthylifestyle",

INSTAGRAM 2022 YILINA ÖZEL REELS ŞABLONU YAYINLADI!👇

Instagram’daki Reels çılgınlığı hakkında ne düşünüyorsunuz? Sosyal medyanın akım konusundaki nabzını tutan TikTok’un önlenemez yükselişinin ardından Instagram da Reels kısmına ağırlık vermeye devam ediyor!✨

Genellikle tüm sosyal medya platformlarının yıl sonunda yaptığı hazırlıklara katılan Instagram, farkını ortaya koymak için geliştirme çalışmalarına devam ediyor✋

Instagram, kullanıcılarının 2022 yılına ait kullanabilecekleri fotoğraflar ve videolarını takipçileriyle paylaşmalarını sağlayacak bir Reels şablonu hazırladı. Üstelik 14 tane video veya fotoğraf kullanma hakkınız var!👏

Instagram’ın hazırladığı bu şablon sayesinde 2022 yılını artık profillerimizde ölümsüzleştirebileceğiz! Bizim için önemli olan her andan hazırlayabileceğimiz Reelslar’ın bir süre akışımızı meşgul edeceği aşikar.👍

Kendi 2022 özetinizi hazırlamak için akışın üst kısmında bulunan “Kendi özet makarınızı oluşturun”a tıklamalısınız. Eğer sizde bu kısım gözükmüyorsa, şablonlar kısmından 14 fotoğrafınızı seçerek bu akımı otomatik olarak oluşturabilirsiniz.🙌

caption.text:
What do you do when you have only 48 hours in Istanbul? Well..everything!! 🤓

JK!! may be not everything 😁but you can still have a pretty decent trip even though you are short on time. 

We did taksim square, Topkapi palace, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand bazar to name a few. We also managed to get Bosphourous cruise in which was the highlight of the trip!!! 

So basically we were just transiting via Istanbul and decided to stay back for some time and taste Turkish cuisine and indulge in Turkish culture for a bit. 

Though the trip didn’t turn out as good as we had hoped for due to their National holiday, flight delays and the fact that Murtaza’s passport got flagged for no reason 🤦🏻‍♀️ but we still managed to had some good time. Our 48 hours of “good”time in a glimpse!

caption.text:
I got used to driving a car. 
I had great laughs with mom&sis.
I had first abroad trip with my brother. It was full of fun including sun burn🔥 
Sena visited me. Miss her a lot. We got poisoned together.
Utku got married. The most beautiful wedding I’ve ever had fun. 
I went to Germany to see old friends. I miss old times. Yunus told me a funniest secret ever.🤭
Dacha…my grape cake…
I met with wonderful people in Madrid. 
Miguel taught me to cook Tortillas de Patatas.😋
My love met with my family🥰
My niece called me “hala” 
I met with a real queen. Lokumcum. 
A daughter and a father are the greatest company ever in Istanbul. Lucky to have you both Halis&Nur🦋
My cousin got married and I was the mascot of wedding😭
The Muse 90401 was the best performance I’ve seen in a long time. @muse90401 
We lost grandpa. 
I was sick&ill for a long time. Still a bit. 
I had full of stress couple months. Ezgi💋
I’m currently unemployed. I found the peace I’ve been looking for a long time. 
Goodbye 2022. The best wishes for all of you. #health #2023

______
What should be BMI (body mass index) for bariatric surgery❓
📌The body mass index calculated by dividing the weight of the person by the square of his/her height is over 40; 
Patients who cannot lose weight despite professional support and serious exercise.
People with a body mass index above 35 and obesity-related problems such as diabetes, hypertension, knee and joint pain.
patients with a body mass index between 30 and 35 who have diabetes, hypertension, asthma and many similar diseases called "metabolic syndrome". 
In some special conditions, obesity surgery is appropriate.

-TR-
 Obezite cerrahisi için BMI (vücut kitle indeksi) kaç olmalıdır❓
📌Kişinin kilosunun, boyunun karesine bölünmesi ile hesaplanan vücut kitle endeksinin 40’ın üzerinde olduğu; 
profesyonel destek ve ciddi egzersize rağmen kilo veremeyen hastalar.
vücut kitle endeksinin 35’in üzerinde olduğu ve obeziteye bağlı diyabet, hipertansiyon, diz ve eklem ağrıları gibi sorunların geliştiği kişiler.

birlikte olduğu bazı özel koşullarda obezite cerrahisi yapılması uygundur.
